firstOpen.text: open uses an opaque continuationId generated by Main with 32 CSPRNG bytes. The server first looks for an existing active record bound to that handle: an exact immutable principal, source, selection, flow and release replay is revalidated and may resume its pinned release even after a newer publication; a conflicting binding is rejected. If no record exists, the first open requires a current-release entitlement, validates the whole graph and creates a server-owned continuation bound to the authenticated account and session before returning ContinuationReceipt. First open of a non-current release is rejected. Other actions require that exact continuationId and a live matching entitlement. next/choose require a legal edge and Main-enforced task confirmations. copy requires an exact task script EntryRef and copies only its FAQ answer without advancing. Each check revalidates current session/grants, current explicit flow and entry disable, original effective intervals, current source authority, the retained valid original mapping and object bindings. The graph candidate templateVersion is read from the pinned published lineage and must match format.templateVersion; an action never accepts a caller-supplied version or promotes an old v1 workbook by relabeling. Newer release alone does not invalidate an active old continuation. New open always uses content_current. No progress is trusted from renderer.

invalidation.text: Explicit flow, resource or entry disable since opening, authoritative source-version suspension, real content expiry, explicit logout, application exit and completed flow make the continuation unusable; later re-enablement or a new grant does not revive disabled, suspended-source or expired content. A valid newer release or automatic session expiry alone does not end the flow.

resume.text: Main generates the sct_ handle from 32 CSPRNG bytes and keeps it only in the running application process; the server stores its hash and proves that this exact flow was opened while its release was current. It is independent of the 300-second entitlement and needs no heartbeat. While the bound ProductSession is live, authenticate that session. If it expired automatically without explicit revocation a newly authenticated ProductSession for the same principal and account may rebind the locked active record; recheck the old session state, current identity, source scope, shop/selection, query and ancestor grants, explicit content disable events since open, original authoritative source-version suspension, content times, approval, exact pinned graph and all dependencies. A different account, a revoked or unverifiable old session, logout, or a changed immutable flow binding fails closed. The current valid grant chain may differ from the opening chain. Only then issue a NEW existing-model bounded entitlement and lease for the server-derived original release, tied to that continuation. The request contains no release, flow, principal or old entitlement. The receipt returns the existing full IntakeEntitlement for the newly issued current scopes and shop, together with the continuationId; never reuse the old scope projection. No session or content validity is extended. The server obtains the original shop, product and scenario selections from the recorded opening entitlement and its context, not from a renderer or arbitrary request. Main preserves only the original selection IDs and progress in process memory, supplies its new contextGeneration in the renew request, and restores the selection view only after the server revalidates that exact selection and returns the new entitlement. A missing or now unauthorized selection fails closed.

restart.text: An online finish or explicit logout atomically closes the server record and clears its session reference before acknowledgement; application exit and offline logout discard the in-process handle and progress. The server cannot observe an undelivered close or independently prove that an idle process remains open. Actual content disable, authoritative source-version suspension or real content expiry also make the flow unusable. Automatic session expiry, temporary loss of query authorization or source membership, a network interruption, or five-minute entitlement expiry suspends protected access but does not itself close an otherwise valid flow. After automatic session expiry, a successful login to the same account may rebind as described in resume; explicit logout must never use this path. Restart is a Main-owned sequence: close the old continuation, then read the current release and explicitly open it to obtain a new receipt; if opening fails, show the failure without claiming the old flow restarted. Retry a lost close or open response using the same Main-owned continuationId and immutable binding; a mismatched replay fails closed. An offline finish or logout discards the in-memory handle and progress; a remote system cannot know a close that has not reached it. No cross-restart recovery is promised.

rollback.text: Rollback creates a new release by copying the entire chosen catalog and all lineage, with fresh authorization/source/object validation. Never independently rewind a SOP pointer.

explicitDisable.text: Only approved active mapped rows enter a candidate; blank rows inherit, only explicit disable changes availability; review names are not authenticated authorization.

rollbackScope.text: 重算实际影响集合；覆盖不了全部范围时返回 requiresCorrectiveCandidate，不允许调用全目录回退。
